items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: only a small group, just one trombone, a trumpet and three saxophones, and the drummer, who was -- oh, who was it?

ctx.x: And that was from an article from about the same period. Juan, could you tell me about your dancing?

Oh, with Harry James and his wife, you know, we were going to Las Vegas -- only a small group, just one trombone, a trumpet and three saxophones, and the drummer, who was -- oh, who was it? The best drummer -- supposed to be the best white drummer in the business.
